answers.core: **BaseButton** has a bunch of core signals: `button_down`, `button_up`, `pressed`, `toggled`. All referring to basic interactions with the Button through the Mouse or Shortcuts. I feel `hovered` should also be available, given it falls under the same group: a core interaction the Mouse has with the UI, hovering it when enabled.
answers.workaround: Yeah, by using `mouse_entered` and checking if `disabled` is true or false within, but this requires for whichever script is reacting to the signal to have access to the Button in order to check its `disabled` var, when more often than not you just need to know if the Button was being hovered while enabled.

title: Add 'hovered' signal on BaseButton which is emitted if the Mouse hovers the Button when NOT disabled
